properties.description: Synchronous reset clears both response valids after the edge, without suppressing legitimate pre-reset presentations.
A blocked data presentation retains valid, byte and last across each edge unless reset cancels it.
A blocked status retains valid and all status fields, independently of data-channel readiness.
Every presented byte is justified by the accepted input prefix in frame order: preserve the first eight bytes and insert zero padding only after input completion.
Every presented status belongs to the next completed accepted frame and reports its original length, clamped length, padding and truncation flags exactly.

Last marks exactly the adjusted output-frame boundary. After a continuous 128-edge ready-high, reset-low, no-offer drain tail, no incomplete frame or outstanding data/status obligation may remain within the bounded tracked history.
